name: Berggasthof Moosbauer
beschreibung: The Berggasthof Moosbauer is located in the municipality of Erl in the Tiroler Unterinntal. The house is run as a traditional inn and offers both overnight accommodation and food and drink. The kitchen serves mainly regional and seasonal dishes. The guest rooms are practically furnished and have modern sanitary facilities. Various hiking trails in the Kaisergebirge can be reached from the inn. The Passion Play community of Erl is in the immediate vicinity.
